subject.title: I updated Scrapling and the skill became hidden again

question: Should Scrapling be restored as a false positive, kept hidden under the web-scraping/content policy, or treated as a publish/update regression that needs a code fix?
rationale: The decisive evidence is private production moderation/audit state plus maintainer policy intent for scraping skills; automation cannot safely unlock a security-hidden public listing or infer content-policy direction from source alone.

options.title: Private moderation review and restore if false positive
options.body: Inspect the current production moderation record and restore or manually override the skill if the scanner or publish flow produced an unintended hide.

options.title: Keep hidden under policy
options.body: If the current policy is to block this class of scraping skill, explain that outcome to the reporter and point discussion to the open content-policy RFC.

options.title: Open a focused code fix
options.body: If production state shows an update-flow regression, keep this issue open as the user-facing report and implement a narrow fix with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Private moderation review and restore if false positive
recommendation.body: Inspect the current production moderation record and restore or manually override the skill if the scanner or publish flow produced an unintended hide.

likelyOwner.reason: He previously restored the same Scrapling listing and authored the recent moderation/publish recovery code paths.
